annotations.exact_quote: Deep Attention-guided Graph Clustering with Dual Self-supervision
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确为深度聚类；摘要用可学习的自编码器/GCN表示与聚类分配直接获得聚类结果，符合深度聚类定义。
摘要说明在每层使用图卷积网络学习表示，属于图上的可学习消息传递。

annotations.exact_quote: To better explore the discriminative information from the cluster assignments, we develop a dual self-supervision solution consisting of a soft self-supervision strategy with a triplet Kullback-Leibler divergence loss and a hard self-supervision strategy with a pseudo supervision loss.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要称利用聚类分配并通过硬自监督的伪监督损失优化，符合将模型预测作为后续训练信号的自训练/伪标签设定。
